Iskra proposes, Szlif evaluates — paired interaction vignette Iskra the fox proposes, Szlif the raven evaluates with a plan notebook. Composed from the master pair with deterministic transforms.
Szlif — master raven vector (direction A refined, with plan notebook) Iskra the fox proposes, Szlif the raven evaluates with a plan notebook. Composed from the master pair with deterministic transforms.
Szlif — style direction A, perched thinker with swept crest Design exploration A for Szlif the raven: heavy wedge head with a long down-hooked ochre beak and a gape line, three crest feathers swept back along the crown, broad shoulders tapering to the rump, folded wing with stepped primary tips breaking the silhouette, fanned tail wedge, bent bird legs and a slim perch. Flat vector, four colours.
/>
Iskra — master fox vector (direction A refined) Iskra the fox proposes, Szlif the raven evaluates with a plan notebook. Composed from the master pair with deterministic transforms.
Iskra — style direction A, soft-round three-quarter sitter Design exploration A for Iskra the fox: soft-round construction, three-quarter head whose silhouette tapers into a projecting snout, small almond eyes, asymmetric brow fringe, tilted turquoise scarf with knot and flying end, one raised foreleg with attached paw, large tail integrated at the haunch. Flat vector, five colours.
